notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33315409/5ed81780942070c78f937245a1338575f80eb3d3.png[/img]

Hi everyone, we hope you are all staying healthy and safe. We are ecstatic to share that August 23rd is our 2 year anniversary from when the original Commission launched. In celebration of this milestone, we are doing a hefty sale (80% off) from August 20th to September 1st! 

We hope everyone can get the chance to play the original commission, as a team it was our first game together and it means so much to us! We'd like to thank the community and everyone who has played the game or helped in any way.

Did you hear? A new iteration of the Commission is coming soon!

[h1]The Commission 1920 [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33315409/4421cdd33ae9402a6fefbc53b4c9783efdff03c6.png[/img]

After the release of the original, we had plenty of ideas on how to improve the game. Strategy games are complex, and it’s not always possible to foresee how every design choice will play out. Seeing all the pieces in motion, and receiving everyone's feedback, we came to the conclusion that the changes we wanted to make went beyond the scope of an ordinary update.

We started with a clean slate, and painstakingly rebuilt every single system from the ground up. Our goal was to reimagine how these systems interacted on a macro level, rather than limit ourselves to minor tweaks. In addition, the Commission 1920 will feature major enhancements to the UI, and plenty of new content.

Learn more on it's steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330960/The_Commission_1920_Organized_Crime_Grand_Strategy/

notes.title: The Commission 1920 Open Alpha
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have been working hard on bringing you The Commission 1920 and are finally ready to share the game in alpha. We will be opening up an Alpha Playtest event starting July 24th! With alpha testing, we want to make sure we have the time to get everyone’s feedback and get the appropriate time needed to update things. With the current state of the game there are no tutorial features, we highly recommend players who played the original commission or seasoned strategy players.

In other news, over this last month we’ve been getting some questions about the release time for The Commission 1920. We originally were planning for a late summer release but we realized that to deliver a game we are truly proud of we are going need more time.

We want to make it the best game it can be and to do that properly we’ve decided to extend the release date to the end of the year.


We hope with this extra time we can make the Commission the best game it can be and work with the community to make that happen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33315409/3f5846e76585cb6656091e9055eafb1cae64bf81.png[/img]

That being said…..we’re doing an Open Alpha Playtest starting July 24th! We’d like to open this up for everyone but please keep in mind that there will be no tutorial. We highly recommend players who played the original commission or seasoned strategy players.

[h1]Open Alpha Testing[/h1]

The Open Alpha will start on July 24th, this means we’ll be giving a handful of players an early look at the game to get your feedback and thoughts so far! The event will span roughly two weeks ending on, August 9th.

In order to participate in the event please sign up here! Please keep in mind that there’s only a handful of slots so remember to sign up as soon as possible :)

We will be actively working and talking with the community throughout the event via our Discord. Join us there to chat with us!

By participating in the event you’ll also get a nifty Discord role in the server as well.

We’re super excited to have everyone be able to check out the game and looking forward to hearing what you think!

[h2]Content Creators[/h2]
Are you a content creator and interested in featuring the game? Reach out to us directly at collaborate[at]302llc[dot]com or reach out to us on Discord :)! We’d love to work with you.

notes.title: Game Announcement: The Commission 1920
notes.notes:
Good news, the books are opening up![url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/798830/The_Commission_Organized_Crime_Grand_Strategy/] The Commission: Organized Crime[/url] is expanding with a
professional remaster. The five families are seeking out promising new leadership. They’re
looking for level-headed loyalty with the power moves to match. So, it’s time for decisions,
decisions. Who’s your clan? How will you run your administration? Prepare to get your hands
dirty in the criminal mafia world because the action begins later this summer. And remember,
there’s always room for one more in the family.

[b][h1]From New Shore with love…[/h1][/b]
As you may have already guessed we have a love for the strategy and grand strategy genres the 302 and 2:30AM teams have hundreds of hours on titles like Europa Universalis, Hearts of Iron, Total War, Age of Empires, etc. The Commission and Commission 1920 are our dive into the genre. We have matured a bit as a studio since our last release, taking lessons learned, feedback and reviews into consideration. We are excited to apply all of these things to this next iteration.

 A word from our team and our Lead Developer, Zachary Goodless, 

“I'd like to give a huge thanks to everyone who played the original Commission. It's been hard work, but I'm excited for you all to see the definitive version of the game, based on your feedback and our own internal wishlist of features. Hope you're all equally as excited to revisit the city of New Shore!”

The Commission is a turn-based grand strategy game where you play as one of many mafia families operating in the city of New Shore. Invest in illegal rackets and recruit associates into your family. Will you take to the streets and claim your territory through brute force? Or will you be an unseen influence, bribing city politicians into your grasp? Either way, climb the ranks of the Commission and become the boss of all bosses!

[b][h1]The Commission 1920[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33315409/51cea2172d0b77d703c9d37dc4eac987c0df7ca7.png[/img]


The Commission 1920 gets a new logo! In this iteration, we take inspiration from 1920’s art deco elements. Mafia life is violent and in those days it was even more so. We’ve added the Cityscape of New Shore and blood splatters to represent the violent history of the mafia. Although The Commission 1920 is a re-imagining of the previous game we still wanted to incorporate the older game’s art deco elements. You’ll see a similar style in the updated logo.

[b][h1]What’s new?[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33315409/17c98360836cdc6a71b0344f2a87ee21d0ef3045.png[/img]


The Commission 1920 will be released with a number of improvements and new features.
Rackets (illegal activities which generate profit) and traits have been rebalanced, with some new
ones to discover!

Want to dig up some dirt on other families? You can now gain intel on opposing families and
target enemy units for assassination or recruitment. You can also reward units for their hard
work by assigning titles, granting benefits, but also fueling the jealousy of their disloyal peers.

Caporegimes are the direct subordinates of the Don, and are in charge of recruiting your
family’s forces. You can manage their unique agendas to keep the cash flowing!

In The Commission 1920, the Commission ranking system has been completely reworked! The
families of New Shore are now ranked among mafia families from across the country. Those
who manage to stand out among the 14 families will reap the benefits. Strive to be the boss of
all bosses, and solidify your legacy within mafia history!

[b][h1]Stay Tuned![/h1][/b]
Tip your newsboys and read your daily newsfeeds for more information and updates about The
Commission 1920. We will continue to provide intel via blogs, dev logs,  [url=http://eepurl.com/defwKv]newsletters[/url], our studios’ [url=https://302interactive.com/]website[/url], and our various social media channels. As development continues, we would love to address any questions/feedback you may have about the upcoming release.

Give us a shakedown. We promise not to order any messages through the mouth. We would
love to hear your thoughts and input about the coming game release. Consider this an offer you can’t refuse, an opportunity to possibly change the course of history (or feature in the game).

Thank you again for your continued support, as we all look forward to getting our hands dirty!

Grazie

notes.title: The Commission Wins Indie Awards at Indieversary
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315409/63040b87e45c8c44b2aa8c06abe78ad7fdaddd51.jpg[/img]

[b]The Commission Wins Indie Awards at Indieversary[/b]

The Indie Awards is hosted at the annual Indieversary event, hosted by Indienomicon. Indienomicon is an organization that celebrates the culture and creativity of independent games. They host game jams, meetups, pub crawls, and more. Some of their annual events include Indieversary and the Indie Awards. Every year, there are games nominated for various categories. To be nominated, the team and game must have participated in an Indienomicon event, whether it's demoing a game, presenting a talk, or showcasing it at the events. The category winners are chosen by the Indienomicon community.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315409/cf41ef36a1fa3e4ac3ab22c7ada557876b50638a.png[/img]

We are very excited to share that a game we worked on with 2:30 AM Studios got nominated and won! The Commission won “Best PC/Console Experience” and “Best Full Released Game!” We are very thankful to be part of such an amazing community of passionate developers and game lovers. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315409/5d19e75ddf0a0f26cb8f0d4a31cbaef3f2fb5f23.png[/img]

We’d like to thank our publisher, 2:30 AM Studios, for believing in us and giving us the opportunity to work on The Commission. We’d also like to thank the game’s community of players for being supportive and very helpful in giving us feedback to help make the game better and better! 

In celebration of winning the awards we plan on doing a promotion on the game, so be on the lookout!

notes.title: The Commission:OCGS Patch Notes - v1.22
notes.notes:
[h1][b]NEW CAMPAIGN OPTIONS[/b][/h1]

You can now toggle boroughs and enemy families. Whether you want a 1v1 against the Rocca family, or you want everyone fighting over East Cushman, the option is there! However, achievements can only be unlocked with the original rules of 5 families, 5 boroughs.

[h1][b]FILE NAMING, COPYING, AND DELETING[/b][/h1]

When saving a file, there is now a filename prompt. Copying and deleting saves can be done when loading a file from the main menu.

[h1][b]REMASTERED MUSIC[/b][/h1]

With the recent release of The Commission's OST, many songs have been remastered. We hope you check out the updated versions!

[h1][b]BUG FIXES AND ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*] Adjusted difficulty settings. There is now an "Insane" difficulty, for those seeking a greater challenge.
    [*] Adjusted the cap on number of assigned units in a single location, to prevent issues when playing in an overcrowded custom campaign.assignments.
    [*] Fixed a bug where random events could happen during the tutorial.
    [*] Fixed a bug where the game would crash when the AI couldn't find a proper target for the Police Raid political favor.
    [*] Fixed a memory leak that could occur when loading several files without closing the game.
[/list]

[h1][b]MEME CONTEST EXTENDED[/b][/h1]
The Meme Contest is going to be extended during the week. We wanted to give everyone more time and some materials to use so more people can participate. Winners will be chosen by the community. To learn more and participate in the contest, join our [url=https://discord.gg/eqZKfBH ]Discord[/url].

Remember to please leave a Steam review, to share any thoughts with us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798830/discussions/] discussion page[/url] and any rats (bugs) can be reported [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798830/discussions/0/1734336452581477375/] here[/url]. Thank you!

notes.title: The Commission:OCGS Patch Notes - v1.2
notes.notes:
[h1][b]LOYALTY REWORK[/b][/h1]

The previous iteration of Loyalty wasn't so much a standalone mechanic, as it was a reflection of your success in other areas of the game. With this update, Loyalty now operates on a tier system, and the factors that cause it to shift are more obvious. When mousing over a unit's Loyalty, you can things that are currently making the unit more loyal/disloyal.

[h1][b]NEW LOYALTY TIERS[/b][/h1]
[list]
[h1][b][u]Unwavering[/u][/b][/h1]
    [*] Never sings when arrested.
    [*] Chance of not giving enemies Interrogations.
    [*] Loyalty deterioration from low capo tax is reduced.
    [*] Loyalty shift from promotion or demotion is greatly increased.
    [*] Don Power EXP per turn: 40.

[h1][b][u]Loyal[/u][/b][/h1]
    [*] Rarely sings when arrested.
    [*] Loyalty deterioration from low capo tax is reduced.
    [*] Loyalty shift from promotion or demotion is increased.
    [*] Don Power EXP per turn: 25.

[h1][b][u]Compliant (Baseline)[/u][/b][/h1]
    [*] Sometimes sings when arrested.
    [*] Don Power EXP per turn: 10.

[h1][b][u]Disloyal[/u][/b][/h1]
    [*] Likely to sing when arrested.
    [*] Chance of giving enemies an additional Interrogation.
    [*] Don Power EXP per turn: 5.

[h1][b][u]Treacherous[/u][/b][/h1]
    [*] Always sings when arrested.
    [*] Always give enemies an additional Interrogation.
    [*] Don Experience Gain: 0.
[/list]

[h1][b]ELECTIONS AND RANDOM EVENTS[/b][/h1]

Past Week 10, on turns when the Commission is not active, events may occur. Some events occur randomly, and give you a chance to earn some Influence or Interrogations. Some events will happen at regular intervals, and will allow you to replace the current mayor, district attorney, or police chief.

[h1][b]ASSASSINATION AND AI REWORK[/b][/h1]

Having an endless conflict with the enemy families is an intentional part of the game's design. However, it often felt like assassinations and conflicts weren't useful for gaining an edge over your opponents. Now, assassinations will significantly reduce the likelihood for the AI to take actions against you, for a certain number of turns. In addition, the AI will avoid neighborhoods where soldatos were previously killed.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES AND ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed a bug where enemy soldatos could be promoted from associates that their caporegimes didn't have.
    [*] Fixed a bug where enemy soldatos that were assigned in a different borough than their caporegime would be prevented from changing assignments.
    [*] Fixed a bug where police-related notifications in Tairona could cause the game to crash.
    [*] Adjusted neighborhood icons to look better with large Muscle counts.
    [*] Adjusted location of Windsmere and other neighborhoods to avoid gerrymandering.
    [*] Adjusted AI to reduce frequency of stacking soldatos.
    [*] Adjusted rate of Don Power EXP gain to accommodate Loyalty changes.
    [*] Adjusted guilty chance calculation for legal cases to accommodate Loyalty changes.
    [*] Added display of Interrogation count on the family tree panel.
    [*] Added filters to report panel.
[/list]

[h1][b]UPCOMING[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*] v1.21 Game FIles and Options update.
    [*] Continuing updates on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1491198351] Guide[/url] and [url=http://the-commission-organized-crime-grand-strategy.wikia.com/wiki/The_Commission:_Organized_Crime_Grand_Strategy_Wiki] Wiki[/url].
    [*] Continuing to catch rats and responding to community suggestions.
[/list]

Remember to please leave a Steam review, to share any thoughts with us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798830/discussions/] discussion page[/url] and any rats (bugs) can be reported [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798830/discussions/0/1734336452581477375/] here[/url]. Thank you!

notes.title: The Commission:OCGS Patch Notes - v1.1 [Tutorial]
notes.notes:
[h1][b]TUTORIAL UPDATE[/b][/h1]

We are happy to address one of the most vocal requests for [b][i]The Commission:OCGS[/i][/b], the need for an in game tutorial. We underestimated the difficulty players would have while discovering new tactics and understanding information linked between multiple systems. This update will help newer players feel confident in their abilities to reign over the city of New Shore while also giving our more dedicated players a new take at systems that might have been overlooked. We are also continuing development on external guides which are linked below. Thank you all for your patience and continued input. We look forward to hearing more from you soon!

[h1][b]FEATURE UPDATES[/b][/h1]

    [*] Adjusted initial funds for each difficulty level.

notes.title: The Commission:OCGS Patch Notes - v1.01 & v1.02
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone so far for your feedback on [i][b]The Commission:OCGS[/b][/i]. We appreciate it all very much as we take into account everything shared with us to continue making a better gameplay experience. Remember to please leave a Steam review, to share any thoughts with us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798830/discussions/] discussion page[/url] and any rats (bugs) can be reported [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798830/discussions/0/1734336452581477375/] here[/url].

[h1][b]RACKET REBALANCING[/b][/h1]
Some substantial changes were made to help balance gameplay, and were done with the following goals in mind:
[list]
    [*] Increase the cost range of rackets, to improve sense of progression. Rackets such as Mugging and Gambling Den are more clearly defined as "starter" rackets.

    [*]Reign in some rackets that were outliers as far as profitability. An example was Robbery, which generated profit even in extremely ill-suited locations.

    [*]Normalize racket investment cost to around 10%-20% of the base cost. Loan Sharking and Insurance Fraud are notable exceptions, with an investment cost of 50%, allowing for faster investment if you can afford it.

[*]Make racket perks more affordable. Specializing is now a much more viable tactic!
[/list]

[h1][b]FEATURE UPDATES[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*] AI is less likely to invest itself into bankruptcy and is less likely to use political favors early in the game. The AI also now shifts its priorities periodically, between profit, recruitment, and conflict.

    [*] When viewing the list of rackets and potential rackets in a neighborhood, you can now toggle the sorting method (alphabetical or cheapest first).
[/list]

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed a bug where adjusting the number of soldatos in a neighborhood was mistakenly treated as leaving the neighborhood, resulting in destroyed racket investments.

    [*] Fixed a bug where soldato/caporegime assignment dialogs would allow you to choose that unit's current assignment as a destination.

    [*] Fixed a bug where neighborhood/borough assignment dialogs would allow you to choose a unit that's already in that location.
[/list]

[h1][b]BUG FIXES V1.02[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed a bug that caused soldato not to be assigned when selecting them from the family tree under certain circumstances.
[/list]

[h1][b]UPCOMING[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*] Continuing development and testing of a Mac build for The Commission:OCGS.
    [*] Finalizing a game tutorial.
    [*] Continuing updates on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1491198351] Guide[/url] and [url=http://the-commission-organized-crime-grand-strategy.wikia.com/wiki/The_Commission:_Organized_Crime_Grand_Strategy_Wiki] Wiki[/url].
    [*] Continuing to catch rats and responding to community suggestions.
[/list]
